instrument: cursor-cloud list-cloud-agents, read-only, limit 200, one page, hasMore=false
method: Verbatim projection of the tool result taken in this run immediately before the write declaration was generated. Only the four fields the concurrency gate reads are carried through; the full result also contained repoUrl, owningUser, timestamps and dashboard URLs for each agent, none of which the gate consults. Nothing is inferred and no agent is omitted: agentCount, returned and totalMatched were all 19 and hasMore was false, so this is the complete accessible set rather than a page of it.

agents.name: Lane B: extend the self-improvement chain
Lane C: authorship sidecar real worker

reading: Six SCP-SI-01 sibling lanes are live and each writes its own namespace. No agent in the accessible set holds cursor/scp-c-authorship-sidecar-696d, and no agent's branchName collides with it. A null branchName is not evidence of idleness on this ref: it means the run has not registered a branch with the platform, which is true of lane C itself at observation time. So the ref-level check that actually decides the gate is git ls-remote on the target ref, recorded separately in the declaration, and this list is the agent-level half of the same question.
limitation: This is the set accessible to this run's principal. An agent belonging to another principal, or a human pushing directly, would not appear. The gate therefore also recomputes the live remote ref, which catches a writer this list cannot see.
